chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) on one of the days of Siffin

key_terms.أَيَّامِ: Days, plural of day, indicating the specific timeframe of the event.
key_terms.خُطْبَتِهِ: His sermon, referring to the formal speech delivered by Imam Ali.
key_terms.صِفِّينَ: Siffin, a location in Syria where the Battle of Siffin took place between Imam Ali and Muawiyah I.

ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's sermons during the Battle of Siffin?
ai.summary: This heading from Sharif al-Radi’s *Nahj al-Balagha* situates the sermon within the specific historical context of the Battle of Siffin (657 CE), marking a critical juncture in the First Fitna where Imam Ali confronted the forces of Mu'awiya. It highlights the rhetorical and theological depth of Ali’s address, which served not only to justify his claim to leadership but also to articulate key Shia principles of justice and divine appointment amidst political turmoil.
